.SYNOPSIS...High pressure will move E and SE over the waters
today, then slowly shift S and E of the area tonight. A series of
cold fronts or low pressure troughs will approach from the W and
NW Tue into Tue night, then pass E and SE over the area late Tue
night through Fri night.
